---
name: Incident task
about: Preserve approved behavior while making a reviewable change
---
## Problem / requested behavior

## Sources read
General adopted commit, project AGENTS, relevant specs and open/closed issues including comments.

## Scope and must-preserve behavior
Include AfterFall A1–A8 for falls or shared-layer changes.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Expected outputs and ordinary success case identified.
- [ ] Failure and regression cases appropriate to the change.
- [ ] Manual edits, uncertainty, chronology and action status preserved.

## Evidence and delivery
Exact commands/results, source commits, browser/mock/live API distinctions, deployment version or explicit not-deployed status.
